newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume sharply lower, prices steady.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume sharply lower, prices steady.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange shrank further to 210 kilos on Friday from Thursday's 465 kilos and Wednesday's 750 amid thin domestic demand and continuing bearish sentiment in world markets, dealers said.

Gold closed at $355.30 an ounce from $355.00 on Thursday in line with the slight rise in the European markets. It also rose to 1,295,000 lira per gram from a previous 1,279,900 with the help of a weaker lira.
Morning turnover was 200 kilos, with no dollar term trade seen in the afternoon. Some 52.4 percent of total turnover was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
